dish.title: Lemon Garlic Shrimp Pasta
dish.name: Lemon Garlic Shrimp Pasta
dish.description: Shrimp seared with garlic in olive oil and tossed with lemon, parsley, and pasta from a salted pot.

recipe_version.title: Lemon Garlic Shrimp Pasta
recipe_version.description: Shrimp seared with garlic in olive oil and tossed with lemon, parsley, and pasta from a salted pot.
recipe_version.doneness: Shrimp are pink and opaque and the thickest piece is 145 F. Pasta is al dente.

ingredients.name: lemon
ingredients.note: Zest of both, juice of 1, the second as wedges.

ingredients.name: Diamond Crystal kosher salt
ingredients.note: Divided: 28 g in 3 qt pasta water (about 1%), 3 g on the shrimp. 31 g Diamond Crystal kosher salt (11 tsp). The same weight is 6.5 tsp Morton coarse kosher salt or 5.25 tsp table salt. UC ANR publication 390575 (November 2023): Diamond Crystal kosher salt 2.8 g per teaspoon, Morton coarse kosher salt 4.8 g per teaspoon, table salt 6 g per teaspoon.

steps.title: Boil the pasta
steps.body: Bring the water to a boil with 28 g of the Diamond Crystal kosher salt (about 1% by weight, 28 g per 3 qt). Boil the linguine until al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water, then drain.

steps.title: Sear the shrimp
steps.body: Pat the large shrimp dry and season with the remaining 3 g Diamond Crystal kosher salt and the black pepper. Sear them in the olive oil with the garlic over medium-high heat, about 2 minutes per side, until pink, opaque, and 145 F in the thickest piece.

steps.title: Finish
steps.body: Off the heat, toss the linguine with the shrimp, the lemon zest and juice, the parsley, and a splash of pasta water. Taste a noodle and a shrimp, both cooked, and add lemon or a pinch of salt only if the bowl needs it. Serve with the remaining lemon wedges.
